opening.argument: The concrete instruction to buy 10 STRONG tokens for a node, followed by directions to send them to a MetaMask account on the Ethereum blockchain, makes this an active purchase solicitation. The speaker presents the arrangement as an easy route to recurring income, asserting that “basically in 100 days you'll you'll break even and everything after that's profits.” He acknowledges that rewards may fail if fewer participants join and even says it could be a Ponzi, but still reassures viewers that the nodes are being created and likely to operate long enough to recover the purchase cost. Those warnings qualify the presentation without displacing its central purchase invitation and optimistic recovery claim.
